caption:
Swipe through 👉 OpenAI's own research just showed workers are quietly doing jobs they were never hired for

OpenAI's research on ChatGPT at work, how workers are crossing into tasks outside their job description, what this shift means for specialists and hiring, and why businesses that adapt first will pull ahead.

The line between "your job" and "someone else's job" is disappearing faster than companies can keep up. AI didn't replace workers — it made every worker able to do more than their title says. The businesses that set this up on purpose will outrun the ones still hiring by role.
